title: Shadow-Cloaked Ring
summary: Adds 1d4 damage to qualifying hits against obscured or shadow creatures.

fields.Shadowthief: Adds 1d4 damage to weapon attacks, unarmed strikes and throws against lightly or heavily obscured targets or creatures made of shadow. Throw attacks with a Thrown weapon can trigger the bonus twice.
fields.Acquisition: Loot the Shadow Mastiff Alpha in the Ruined Battlefield camp. Destroy the everburning torches to make it appear.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
